items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: And Jesse used to call him Catford

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And Jesse used to call him Catford, my Jesse used to play banjo. And all them was in the band again. And this fella called, what I called, Zula. This fella was playing Clang at, uh...
